scope: ANP national Diesel B S10 resale price in BRL/litre; endogenous features only
calibration_rationale: 26 contiguous prior weeks for all models/folds avoid the 2020 ANP gap and retain the three original 52-week development folds. Initial alpha stays nominal with fewer than 40 residuals, as in production; subsequent updates adapt it.
selection_policy: No search or promotion in this protocol. Compare all three fixed models on development only.
holdout_policy: 2024-08-18..2026-08-09 already consulted; inaccessible to evaluator; not independent final evidence.
candidate_provenance: Legacy development candidate random_015_lags_delta, frozen with robust_bounded scaling from the corrected pipeline; not a new winner claim.
availability_assumption: Origin price is assumed published before issue; retrospective week labels do not establish actual publication time.
